name: pnge-well-engineering
description: Completions and production wellwork as one workflow: frac design (PKN/KGD, Nolte-Smith), wellbore stability (Kirsch, mud window), petrophysics (Archie/Simandoux, brittleness), perforation design, DFIT/minifrac diagnostics, matrix acidizing, tubing design (Lubinski), artificial lift (rod/ESP/gas-lift/plunger), flow assurance (hydrates/scale/corrosion), surface facilities, RTA/DCA, well-test analysis, nodal analysis, production chemistry, well-integrity/SCP triage, PVT, stage-treatment + surveillance review, plus KGS well-log and Macrostrat stratigraphy references. Includes api-well-standards agent and /completions-design.
